units.note: x and z are studs from the baseplate front-left corner (x right, z away from the builder). y is plate heights above the baseplate top (a brick is 3 plates). x, z are the minimum corner of the piece footprint after rotation.

steps.title: Set the baseplate
steps.instruction: Put the baseplate just behind the marker, with its front edge facing you.

steps.title: Front wall, left
steps.instruction: Place the 2×4 red brick on the baseplate, one stud in from the left and two studs back.

steps.title: Front wall, right
steps.instruction: Add the 2×2 red brick right next to it, to finish the front row.

steps.title: Back wall, left
steps.instruction: Place the 2×2 red brick directly behind the left end of the front row.

steps.title: Back wall, right
steps.instruction: Finish the back row with the 2×4 red brick. It should overlap the seam in the front row.

steps.title: Second layer, front left
steps.instruction: Start the white layer with a 2×2 brick on the front left corner.

steps.title: Second layer, front right
steps.instruction: Add the 2×4 white brick next to it, covering the seam below.

steps.title: Second layer, back left
steps.instruction: Place the 2×4 white brick on the back row, starting at the left edge.

steps.title: Second layer, back right
steps.instruction: Close the back row with the last 2×2 white brick.

steps.title: Add the roof
steps.instruction: Lay three 2×4 gray plates across the top, turned sideways, left to right.

steps.title: Add the chimney
steps.instruction: Place the 2×2 red brick on the front right corner of the roof.

steps.title: All done
steps.instruction: Your cabin is finished. Walk around it to see every side.
